registry_policy.purpose: Capability and dependency catalog for repository automation programs.
registry_policy.registration_required_for: Any Python component under scripts/ and any GitHub Actions workflow under .github/workflows/.
registry_policy.collaboration_rule: A program may run independently under its own entry point. Cross-program orchestration requires an explicit registry entry and declared workflow dependencies or dispatch targets.
registry_policy.permission_rule: Registry declarations describe boundaries; they never grant permissions. The workflow job's least-privilege permissions remain authoritative.
registry_policy.activation_rule: Registration is mandatory for CI acceptance, but does not by itself authorize automatic dispatch, rule activation, publication, or modification of shadowrocket/ss.conf.

programs.responsibility: plan and execute only explicitly enabled, reviewed Python CLI or GitHub Actions workflow adapters with durable dispatch intent and least-privilege credentials

program registry
reviewed execution adapter inventory
worker identity and task limit
outputs: processed task summaries
blocked task reasons
persisted workflow dispatch intents
independent workflow run verification results
programs.permission_boundary: Requires caller-provided GitHub Contents read/write permission. Child programs receive only a non-secret environment allowlist, no shell, and no GitHub token. The scheduler does not modify shadowrocket/ss.conf.

programs.responsibility: validate workflow dispatch inputs, submit a uniquely correlated GitHub Actions dispatch, and independently inspect its run identity and conclusion

authorized task envelope
allowlisted GitHub ref
caller-provided GitHub Actions token
outputs: persistable workflow dispatch intent
correlated workflow run evidence
pending or failed run state
programs.permission_boundary: Requires caller-provided actions:write for dispatch and actions:read for run inspection. Tokens are never returned in results or passed to child programs. This module does not modify shadowrocket/ss.conf.
programs.health_check: Unit tests cover caller/ref/input authorization, live workflow identity, correlation marker injection, ambiguous run detection, run identity validation, and completed-success verification.
